clips.title: Quest text
paras: Oh my, you look like death. Correction - I've seen death, you look worse than death. You, sir, would be what death coughed up at his last physical.
Hah! You hear that Noarm? Write that one down!
Hrm yes, in order for me to help you, I'll need to draw some blood. Don't worry, it only hurts the first few... Fifty times or so... /lay down when you're ready for the treatment, friend.

sources.title: Quest text one player sent in, not confirmed by a second yet
